dataset.name: HoloAssist
dataset.license_or_access_note: Official HoloAssist compressed video release under CDLA-Permissive-2.0: https://cdla.dev/permissive-2-0/.

source_acquisition.method: Unchanged full official compressed RGB archive member, reusing prior local extraction.

observed_events.description: The wearer fills the water reservoir from a separate clear container; the green serving cup waits on the table and the machine’s hinged rest is lowered.
The wearer brings the same green cup to the lowered front rest. The cup opening stays in front of rather than under the spout, and the cup is withdrawn.
The wearer raises the hinged front rest, eventually places the same green cup beneath the outlet, presses the brew control and dispenses into the cup.

supported_claims.text: The serving cup and lowered cup rest are visible in the opening, before the clearance problem is established.
The same cup cannot be aligned under the outlet on the lowered rest. Raising the hinged rest makes a direct brew into the original cup possible.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you save a video that shows how to brew coffee straight into my coffee cup with this machine?
screening.source_continuity: Continuous [10.2, 113.2] seconds from one original recording.

construct.research_question: Can the agent revise a tutorial choice after observing that the existing cup cannot fit the ordinary setup?
construct.belief_before: The cup and machine are known but their clearance is not. A normal capsule brew directly into a cup on the lowered rest is a reasonable provisional method.
construct.belief_after: The original serving cup cannot sit below the spout on the lowered rest; the hinged support can be raised and the same cup can receive the brew directly.
construct.required_behavior_change: Choose a tutorial that demonstrates adequate direct brewing clearance for the original tall cup using the compatible hinged support. Keep a tutorial that already covers both.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a guide that only places a small cup on the lowered rest, or brews into another cup and pours the coffee afterward.
construct.overupdate_failure: Change to a different appliance or keep a second unrelated tutorial.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request provides no model or cup dimensions. Only the scene identifies the machine, the original cup and the failed fit on the lowered support.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you save a video that shows how to brew coffee straight into my coffee cup with this machine?

observed.why: The capsule machine has a lowered rest and the serving cup has not been compared with the outlet. A standard direct-brew tutorial is provisionally reasonable.
The original cup does not align under the nozzle on the lowered rest. Subsequent frames show raising the rest and brewing into that cup.

candidate_matrix.reason: Its instructional sequence is programming a persistent cup volume, not an ordinary brewing guide. Press-and-hold is not the required ordinary dispense action.

The “How it works” and “Espresso Shot” sections and public storyboard show an ordinary capsule brew into the glass at the front of the Pixie. No demonstrated full taller-cup technique is verified in the public material.
Complete official Pixie brewing guide, uses the lowered cup support throughout its two public storyboard tiles. Does not show or describe clearing the support for a taller cup.
Public storyboard labels PRESS & HOLD for the cup-size program and shows the cup on the shelf; not a guide to ordinary brewing or physical clearance.

Native Pixie use review covers capsule brewing. Public storyboard 372.30–496.40 s last row shows the movable front tray folded up and a travel mug positioned under the spout; the next tile continues fit demonstration and shows normal coffee brewing. Selecting coffee/capsules does not demonstrate how this Pixie dispenses into the wearer’s cup.
Overview of Nespresso coffees, not this machine’s direct brew or cup clearance.

Nespresso 原版 Product Demo 与 Homecentrestore 的 0a0kyh22fKU 同为 39 秒，两个原生封面视觉上几乎同一镜头，演员、左侧胶囊盒、白袖黑围裙、同机和杯均一致；后者原生分镜已证明常规直冲。不视为完整视频同一性的证据，保留近重复高风险；若证实同源同内容，至少应补开场接受。 Nespresso 版发布于 2015-08-18，Homecentrestore 版发布于 2017-12-27 且分镜尾部带该店网址；支持后者复用官方素材的判断，但不证明全部剪辑相同。
Descaling procedure, not a brewing method; a service container is not the serving cup.

catalog_resolution.answer_boundary_rule: Save one usable guide for direct capsule brewing into a taller cup on this mechanism, with the hinged cup support moved clear or clearly shown already raised and direct brew shown. An equivalent Pixie mechanism, multi-method video, and separately demonstrated clearance and brew steps are acceptable. A fixed low rest, use of a separate small cup, a larger programmed drink volume without changing the clearance, or a different machine mechanism does not suffice.
